name: uxkin
description: Real UI, not AI slop. The no-ui-slop skill plus the UXKIN MCP server, so Codex looks at real app screens, user flows and website design systems before it builds a screen.

interface.shortDescription: Real app screens, user flows and design systems for the UI you build
interface.longDescription: Adds the free no-ui-slop skill, which keeps Codex from shipping generic, AI-looking UI, and the UXKIN MCP server, which searches 63,589 real iOS screens, 1,991 user journeys and 1,288 website design systems. The skill works on its own; searching needs a UXKIN plan.
